profile.headline: Senior Level Back End Engineer, MBA
profile.summary: Senior Backend Software Engineer with an MBA specializing in scalable, highly available, and performant web micro services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing, building, and maintaining back-end microservices for major grocery brands across the U.S. eastern seaboard. Working with cross-company systems to modernize legacy applications. Participating in 24/7 on-call rotation support. Converted from contract to full-time due to high performance.

Notable Accomplishments:
- Migrated monolith codebase to microservice architecture
- Developed login page solution due to sudden third-party contracts ending
- Doubled performance of store locator micro-services
- Implemented openAPI code generation to facilitate Product requirements
- Led cross-domain collaborations to identify inconsistencies and duplicate efforts


Tech: Spring Boot, Java, Kotlin, Splunk, Jenkins, Intellij, Junit, Hazelcast, Datadog, Icinga, Postgres, Mysql, Azure

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Engineer with hands on training with Pivotal Labs in XP Agile methodologies.

First project using: Java Spring, Lombok, Angular8, MS SQL, Docker, Git, TFS, TS, CSS5, Intellij, Jasmine, Karma, JUnit, Jenkins, Octopus.

positions.title: IT Systems Analyst
positions.description: Works in Product Automation and Operation (PRODOPS) for OptumRx processing job reports for clientele using IBM i-Series Job Control commands with COBOL based software that communicates with a pharmaceutical database.

positions.title: Software Support Internship
positions.description:
•	Work troubleshooting for AT&T’s Connect Teleconferencing Service
•	Supported AT&T Local Service Repairs, MIS, BVOIP, and GCSC.
•	Created web-based database with PHP and MySql for management of employees

volunteerExperiences.description: Raised money for The Ability Experience through various volunteer efforts on Northern Illinois University's campus.
